verdict.line: You lose if you let Camille auto-trade and walk away between cooldowns; you win the moment you land E and force the fight to go long.

brief.thesis: Camille's whole kit is built around hit-and-run: Q (Precision Protocol) grants bonus Move Speed on an empowered auto, and E (Hookshot) lets her dash to a wall and disengage. Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp) pulls all enemies in the area, which erases that disengage the instant it lands, and W (Indestructible) banks the damage from the forced brawl into a shield you can convert to healing. That's why the data shows Mordekaiser holding both the lane win rate (50.8% over 124 games) and the solo-kill edge here — this is a matchup about denying her exit, not out-poking her.

theirWindow.when: she lands Q1 and holds the recast
theirWindow.what: She's waiting out the delay for the bigger recast hit on Precision Protocol. Don't stand still in her 325 range while she charges it — back off a step or force the trade before she can hold it.

yourWindow.when: the moment she closes to auto or Q you
yourWindow.what: Cast E (Death's Grasp, 16/14/12/10/8s CD) immediately to pull her into full range. Follow with Q for passive stacks and W to bank the shield — once she's pulled in without E (Hookshot) up, she has no clean way out.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 76.1% pick rate, 58.5%-win start — mana and sustain to spam E every cooldown without running dry before she can punish an empty bar.

boots.why: 73.7% pick rate. Camille's damage is entirely auto-attack driven (Q empowered hit, passive shield off autos), so flat physical reduction blunts every trade she starts.

core.why: Highest-win core path (78.6% over 14 games). The slow from your Q/E stacks on top of the pull, so once she's locked in she genuinely can't walk out.
Omnivamp turns every forced extended fight into free sustain, compounding the advantage you already have once E lands.
Burn damage punishes her for standing in your pull instead of trying to disengage.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking damage-to-healing conversion rewards exactly the prolonged, locked-in fight you're forcing with E — it does nothing for you if she disengages, everything for you if she can't.

summoners.why: The most-run and highest-win page (53.6% WR, 82.8% pick). Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once E locks her out of her hit-and-run pattern.

playing.title: E the instant she closes
playing.detail: The moment Camille steps into range to auto or use Q, cast E (Death's Grasp) immediately. Waiting even a second lets her land the hit and walk away — the pull only works before she's already extracting.

playing.title: Stack passive during the pull
playing.detail: Darkness Rise needs 3 landed hits on champions or monsters. Use the window after E connects to land Q and autos back-to-back so the aura and Move Speed are live before she can reset.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown, not yours
playing.detail: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s. If she's used it recently and there's no wall in reach, she has no disengage — that's your real all-in window, independent of your own cooldowns.

playing.title: Bank W before you need it
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you can consume to heal. Poke with Q pre-fight so the shield is already loaded when the E-lock trade starts.

playing.title: Don't out-auto her passive
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses shields her against the damage type of any auto she lands on you. Win the trade with the E-Q burst combo, not a straight auto-attack war.

playing.title: Save R to seal a walk-off
playing.detail: If she tries to fight her way out of the E pull mid-trade, R (Realm of Death, 650 range) isolates her from outside help and locks the 1v1 you already have the edge in.

playing.title: Respect Q1 before it recasts
playing.detail: If she lands the first hit of Precision Protocol and backs off, she's holding the recast for bonus damage. Don't walk into her 325 range chasing it — make her come to you into E range instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample-size numbers are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG. The tactical reasoning — why E-lock beats her hit-and-run pattern and the level-by-level power read — is my own analysis of the ability mechanics, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Camille hit and run by using [E] the moment she closes in. Maintain your [P] active to have the upper hand in prolonged fights.
